_captured: 2026-10-22, real responses from https://dchub.cloud with no key (keyless endpoints) and with a deliberately bad key; nothing redacted because no real key was used

provenance.as_of_basis: UNMEASURED — live aggregate of the facility registry at serve time; the registry carries no row-level data vintage. served_on is when it was computed, not when the data was collected. Ingest freshness: /api/v1/ops/deadman.
provenance.method: total_power_mw and facility_count count OPERATIONAL facilities only, with duplicate records excluded — the same basis the rank_markets tool and the DCPI market scores use. pipeline_mw_total is de-duplicated but NOT lifecycle-filtered: it is the construction/planned/permitting sum by definition.
provenance.summing_note: Markets may OVERLAP. Any row with a non-empty `contained_in` is a strict subset of the market(s) it names — e.g. ashburn sits inside northern virginia. Do not add their MW together.

response._upgrade_cta: BUILD/CAUTION/AVOID verdicts, the composite score and the market list are free. The DCPI sub-scores (excess-power, grid-constraint, time-to-power) and risk/opportunity detail unlock with a paid DC Hub plan for agents. A key holding pack credits also opens a single market, at one credit per full answer.
response.data_basis_note: live: gen_additions_12mo_mw, queue_capacity_mw, queue_wait_months, reserve_margin_pct; modeled: btm_headroom_mw, curtailment_pct, demand_growth_yoy_pct, queue_approval_rate_pct

provenance.method: DCPI scoring method_version=2.5.0 (full method: /api/v1/dcpi/methodology); see data_basis/data_basis_source for the score's input basis; signal_tier=full (see signal_tier_note)

response.signal_tier_note: full = all 3 live-capable adapters (interconnect_queue, planned_generators, grid_telemetry) returned data; partial = 1-2; low = 0, or this market's ISO fell through to the WECC default. 'full' does NOT mean every score input is measured — data_basis carries the per-field live/modeled split and the adapter counts.
